about: Labelled memory pairs for calibrating duplicate detection. Each memory is rendered through similar::document() exactly as it is embedded. Classes that must be flagged as possible duplicates: same (restatement or paraphrase), contradiction (same subject, changed mind; resolved by supersedes). Reviewed together as overlaps: exception (narrower project exception; usually embeds like related memories, but one restating the same setting with another value may score like a contradiction and be flagged), related (same area, different subject). Not to be grouped: unrelated, including pairs in one category group on different subjects, which no cutoff separates from exceptions.
